svg.title: Computable triple colouring
svg.desc: For a blue homogeneous set, each interval (tn,tn+1] needs a new first halt from a fixed finite set of programs. A red homogeneous set provides a bound te+1 for every computation Pe(e).

g.aria-label: Blue requires new halts; red bounds all later first halts

g.title: Blue requires new halts; red bounds all later first halts

g.aria-label: Blue: fix the first member t₀; witnesses have eₙ ≤ t₀
g.title: Blue: fix $t_0$; witnesses satisfy $e_n\leq t_0$

g.aria-label: Disjoint intervals need distinct witnesses from {0, …, t₀}.

g.aria-label: Pₑ(e) halts eventually ⇔ Pₑ(e) halts by tₑ₊₁
g.title: $P_e(e)$ halts eventually $\Longleftrightarrow$ $P_e(e)$ halts by $t_{e+1}$

g.aria-label: A computable T would provide a computable bound and decide H.

svg.desc: Figure labels: Blue requires new halts; red bounds all later first halts; Blue: fix the first member t₀; witnesses have eₙ ≤ t₀; first halt of e₁; first halt of e₂; first halt of e₃; first halt of e₄; t₁; t₂; t₃; t₄; t₅; Disjoint intervals need distinct witnesses from {0, …, t₀}.; Red: choose tₑ ≥ e; Pₑ(e) halts eventually ⇔ Pₑ(e) halts by tₑ₊₁; A computable T would provide a computable bound and decide H.
